entries.search: Jan Mayen's quake buried Kjerulf Glacier under a rock avalanche unseen in 40 years of satellite images A magnitude 6.5 earthquake on Jan Mayen on 10 March 2025 triggered a rock avalanche that covered part of the Kjerulf Glacier about 7 km from the epicentre. Because the clocks cannot separate disease-related protein shifts from aging-related ones, the result does not demonstrate rejuvenation or an effect in healthy people.

entries.search: Calculations put a dark-matter-fed black hole's survival threshold at about 40 tonnes A theoretical calculation finds that a miniature black hole of about 40 tonnes could grow without evaporating inside a white dwarf in a dense dark-matter environment. entries.search: The Arctic melt season lengthens by about 7.5 days as autumn freeze-up arrives later A review of roughly 50 years of satellite data led by Melinda Webster at the University of Washington finds the Arctic melt season has lengthened by about 7.5 days since 1979, mostly from a later autumn freeze-up. Webster tells Earth.com that sea ice reflects 60–90 per cent of sunlight while open water reflects about 7 per cent, so the delay lets the ocean absorb more heat and form thinner ice. Bessent said he hoped no further banks would need sanctioning, an outcome he tied to how quickly other governments stop supporting Tehran.
entries.title: US Treasury sanctions Turkey's Golden Global Bank over Iran ties

entries.search: Trapped infrared light at Cornell becomes a 300-femtosecond magnetic field with no magnet involved A germanium metasurface designed by Shivaksh Rawat, Samyobrata Mukherjee and Gennady Shvets at Cornell University traps mid-infrared light. When the array is lit by a short near-infrared pulse, electron-hole pairs appear, the refractive index changes abruptly and part of the stored optical energy passes into a static magnetic field. Neither a magnet nor a magnetic material takes part. entries.search: ADAMTSL4 switches on dormant TGF-β1 in mouse muscle and fat and advances cachexia Helmholtz Munich researchers, with Heidelberg University and the Technical University of Munich, report that ADAMTSL4 binds the latent TGF-β1 complex and releases the active signal in muscle and fat. entries.search: Chevron takes new Orinoco acreage and plans to lift Venezuela output to 600,000 barrels a day Chevron said on Wednesday that it has been assigned additional acreage in Venezuela's Orinoco Belt. It rides down in 2029 on ispace's Mission 4 lander, under a partnership between ESA and Japan's space agency JAXA.
entries.title: ESA's first lunar rover MAGPIE goes to ispace-EUROPE for a 2029 landing at the south pole

entries.search: MIT team rules out the neutrino laser: recoil and fermionic nature close the path Wolfgang Ketterle, Hanzhen Lin and Yu-Kun Lu show in two Physical Review Letters papers that last year's neutrino laser proposal cannot be built. entries.search: Reserve Bank of New Zealand raises the cash rate to 2.75 per cent The Reserve Bank of New Zealand raised its Official Cash Rate by 25 basis points to 2.75 per cent on Wednesday, a second straight increase after July. entries.summary: Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov attended the G20 talks in Asheville, marking his first in-person appearance since 2022.
